title: Trace Causality
next_chapter_hook: Chen Ji decided to act ahead of schedule, not waiting for the secret realm to end before heading to the Holy Sect to rescue someone—yet his whereabouts had long been anticipated by someone.

text.content: Han Lie's corpse still carried warmth, yet Chen Ji could no longer feel the joy of victory. That whisper from the depths of the ruins pierced like an icy needle into the deepest part of his Mental Sea—'Finally waiting for you, the bastard of the Chen family.' The Eye of Heavenly Dao. It had been watching him all along. The surrounding broken murals flickered in the Spiritual Light; the immortal-demon battlefield from a thousand years ago now only remnants of broken walls and ruins remained. Chen Ji stood in Han Lie's pool of blood, robes billowing, yet his gaze pierced through the heavy mist, falling upon some distant direction. Sister. Are you still waiting for me?

dialogue.content: The Tianji Record Fragment suddenly burned hot; Mo Xiansheng's aged voice rang out in the Mental Sea: 'Young master, when you动用天机之力 just now, the fluctuation was too intense... It has already locked onto your aura.' After a pause, that voice continued, 'However, since it appeared on its own, it saves this old man considerable effort. Young master, today this old one can teach you a technique called 'Trace Causality'—it can trace the source of any causally entangled matter. The only cost...' Mo Xiansheng's tone turned grave, 'Your current Heavenly Fate Value cannot sustain many uses.'

text.content: Chen Ji did not hesitate. 'Teach it.' One word, cold and hard as iron. He sat cross-legged, placing the Tianji Record Fragment on his knees. Golden text flowed like water from the page, forming lines of causality around his body. These lines represented the connections between all things in the world—good and evil, kinship and enmity, interests, fate... countless thin lines intertwined into a net, and what Chen Ji needed to do was find the most special thread among them. The thread pointing to his sister. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out again, carrying a trace of sighing: 'Each use of Trace Causality consumes 50 points of Heavenly Fate Value; young master, you now only have 120... Three breaths later, the technique will be complete.'

The first breath. The lines of causality began to tremble; Chen Ji's divine sense was pulled by an invisible force, piercing through the barriers of time and space. He saw the Mountain Gate of the Tianqing Sect, saw a figure holding a baby girl—that was his father Chen Xuan, back turned to him, handing an infant to a black-clad figure. The second breath. The scene flowed rapidly; the infant grew into a child, imprisoned in a gloomy underground altar, surrounded by countless bizarre runes. And standing above the altar was a person. Wearing a dark cyan robe, with an elegant face and an immortal demeanor—the current Sect Master of the Tianqing Sect, Ling Yuan. The third breath. Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji saw Ling Yuan's face, and the suppressed rage churned in his chest. How should he face this truth?

choices.description: Cast aside all restraint, turn anger into tangible power displayed on the spot, letting heaven and earth feel his fury
choices.visible_cost: Consume 30 points of Heavenly Fate Value
choices.visible_reward: Release fury, terrifying all existences in the surroundings
choices.risk_hint: Emotional loss of control may lead to greater vulnerabilities

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes suddenly took on a blood-tinged hue; the spiritual energy around him went out of control and raged violently. The ground cracked, gravel floated, and the ceiling of the ruins began to shower dust. He let out a low laugh, that laughter carrying no warmth whatsoever: 'Ling Yuan... So it was you.' Four words, each like ice shards squeezed from between his teeth. He raised his hand, a sharp sword qi slicing toward the empty space ahead—that was the direction of Ling Yuan, though thousands of miles apart, yet as if determined to behead him beneath the sword.

choices.description: Force down the surging anger, restore calm thinking—raging cannot solve problems, what he needs is a plan
choices.visible_reward: Obtain more complete causal information, including Ling Yuan's weaknesses
choices.risk_hint: Excessive suppression may lead to internal injuries

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes and took a deep breath. When he opened them again, that blood-tinged hue had receded, replaced by a chilling calm. He threw his divine sense back into the Trace Causality, continuing to trace more information. Ling Yuan's face grew clearer among the lines of causality—he saw this 'Sect Master''s secret dealings with the Holy Sect, saw the list of disciples he had betrayed, and also saw the source of his grudge with Chen Ji's father. A faint smile curved Chen Ji's lips, that smile sending a chill through the bone: 'So that's how it is... You're merely a loser after all.'

choices.description: Without waiting for more information, confirm sister's location and set out at once—time waits for no one, every extra moment she suffers more torment
choices.visible_cost: Consume 20 points of Heavenly Fate Value for positioning
choices.visible_reward: Obtain Chen Nian's precise location, with escape route
choices.risk_hint: Reckless action may fall into an ambush

text.content: Chen Ji did not hesitate for long. He condensed the power of Trace Causality into a single point, specifically to lock onto Chen Nian's location. The scene became clear once more—the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds, the Heavenly Fate Altar. That was a forbidden area located at the deepest part of the Holy Sect, rumored to be an altar from ancient times used to communicate with the Heavenly Dao. And Chen Nian was imprisoned at the very center of the altar, serving as the 'key' sealing some door. Chen Ji's fingers trembled slightly; that was the result of anger intertwined with heartache. He murmured: 'Sister, hold on a little longer, I'm coming to rescue you.'

The final image of the karma traceback was a dust-laden memory. Chen Xuan—Chen Ji's father—had been a fellow disciple with Ling Yuan in their youth, and both competed for the inheritance qualification of the Tianji Record. However, the Tianji Record chose Chen Xuan over Ling Yuan. From then on, Ling Yuan appeared obedient on the surface, but secretly colluded with the Holy Sect, scheming step by step for revenge and power grab. He framed Chen Xuan, handed Chen Nian over to the Holy Sect as a 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key,' ascended to the position of Sect Master himself, completing a perfect conspiracy spanning twenty years. And the mastermind behind it all turned out to be that old sect master who kept claiming to 'shelter' Chen Ji—Ling Yuan.

What chilled Chen Ji even more was another image that emerged from the karma traceback. His father Chen Xuan was confronting some nameless entity. That existence had no form—only a massive eye floating in the void, gazing indifferently at all things in the world—the Eye of Heavenly Dao. And in Chen Xuan's hand was unmistakably the complete Tianji Record. He was confronting the Eye of Heavenly Dao directly. Chen Ji drew a sharp breath. The true origin of the Tianji Record was likely far more terrifying than he had imagined. And his father might have been the most crucial piece in this chess game from the very beginning. Mo Xiansheng's voice echoed faintly: 'Young master, now you understand, don't you? Your enemy is far more enormous than you imagined. But likewise... your chips are also more than you thought.'

dialogue.content: 'I have one more thing to tell you.' Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly became solemn. 'When your father passed the Tianji Record to you back then, he left behind a contingency measure. That measure will activate when you are on the brink of despair, granting you a brief opportunity to experience the complete Tianji Record—the cost is that you must make a crucial decision at that moment. That decision will determine the direction of your future path.' He paused, then added, 'Also, your Heavenly Fate value has only seventy points left. The karma traceback consumed too much. If you forcibly use other abilities again, you probably won't survive to rescue your sister.'

text.content: Chen Ji slowly opened his eyes. The surrounding world seemed different—he could see the threads of karma flowing through the air, perceive the trajectories of fate wrapped around each person. This was a side effect of karma traceback, but also a sign of the Tianji Record's power awakening. He looked down at his hands, feeling the changes in his spiritual power within. Unknowingly, stimulated by anger and grief, his cultivation had broken through another minor stage, reaching Foundation Building Ninth Layer. Only one step remained before Golden Core. Yet he felt no joy. Because he knew this single step might require the blood of countless people to cross.

choice.prompt: 'Chen Ji's cultivation broke through, but his Heavenly Fate consumption was severe. How should he plan his next move?'

choices.description: 'No need to rush. First use the information obtained from karma traceback to set up a layout, create chaos within the Holy Sect, then strike'
choices.visible_cost: 'Consume 20 Heavenly Fate points to set up layout'
choices.visible_reward: 'Obtain intelligence from within the Holy Sect and win over some factions'
choices.risk_hint: 'Requires time, sister may not be able to wait'

text.content: Chen Ji stood up, his gaze coldly sweeping his surroundings. Han Lie's Xuanwu Sect disciples had long fled in terror from the commotion, leaving the vast ruins with only him alone. He began rapidly deducing the chess game ahead—the Holy Sect's interior was far from united. Ye Qing, as the Demon Path Saintess, had always been questionable in her loyalty to the Holy Sect. If he could pass her some 'interesting' information... A cold smile curved Chen Ji's lips: 'Ling Yuan, you think you've set an inescapable net, but you don't know that every move of yours was anticipated by my father.'

choices.description: 'No more waiting, immediately head to the Holy Sect Forbidden Grounds—even by risking solitary danger, I cannot let my sister suffer another moment of torment'
choices.visible_reward: 'Approach Chen Nian at the first opportunity'

text.content: Chen Ji hesitated no longer. He tore open a fragment of a teleportation talisman—a lifesaver Mo Xiansheng had given him before, capable of short-distance spatial leap. His figure gradually dissolved in spiritual light, and when he reappeared, he was already among the mountains surrounding the Holy Sect. In the distance, the Holy Sect's forbidden lands were faintly visible, the sky there presenting a诡异 crimson hue, as if dyed with blood. Chen Ji took a deep breath, murmuring softly: 'Sister, brother is here.' His figure transformed into a streak of light, hurtling toward that blood-colored forbidden land.

However, just as Chen Ji was about to reach the edge of the Holy Sect's forbidden lands, a familiar figure blocked his path—Su Qingyao. She stood atop the cliff, her blue garments fluttering, her beautiful face carrying a complex expression. She looked at Chen Ji, her voice clear yet trembling slightly: 'Chen Ji, have you gone mad? That's the Holy Sect's forbidden land—entering is a dead end!' Her hand gripped her sword hilt, her knuckles white, clearly exerting great restraint over something. She must have sensed something amiss and followed the trail here. A warm feeling flickered in Chen Ji's heart, but was immediately replaced by deeper coldness. He could not let anyone be drawn into this vortex, especially not her.

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao bit her lip, a hurt flash crossing her eyes, but was immediately replaced by determination. She stepped forward, sword light suddenly appearing, blocking before Chen Ji: 'Do you think I can't tell? There's my father's aura on you—not that hypocrite Ling Yuan, but the true sect master's aura. Chen Ji, what have you discovered?' Her voice trembled slightly, 'Why... why won't you tell me anything?' Her eyes reddened slightly—this was the first time Chen Ji had seen her so unguarded. For three years, she had been secretly investigating him, approaching the truth again and again only to be deflected by him each time. And now, she chose to confront him directly.

choice.prompt: Su Qingyao blocked Chen Ji's path, her eyes carrying hurt and determination. She was waiting for an answer.

choices.description: 'Reveal everything—Ling Yuan's conspiracy, sister's whereabouts, father's past—make her a true ally'
choices.visible_reward: 'Gain Su Qingyao's full support, unlock the prerequisite for Shared Destiny buff'
choices.risk_hint: 'She may fall into danger because of this'

dialogue.content: Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then slowly spoke, telling her everything he knew—the betrayal of Ling Yuan, his father's wrongful death, his sister's imprisonment, the truth of the Tianji Record. Su Qingyao's face grew paler and paler, and when she heard the name Ling Yuan, her hands trembled violently. "How is this possible... he was the person my father trusted most..." Her voice carried a hint of collapse, but it was immediately replaced by fury. She took a deep breath, and ice-cold flames ignited in her eyes: "Tell me, how do I get to the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds?"

choices.memory_label: 苏青瑶已了解全部真相，并选择与陈机并肩作战

choices.description: To push her away for her protection—this matter was too dangerous, he couldn't let her get involved
choices.visible_reward: Su Qingyao would be temporarily safe, and could serve as backup in the future
choices.risk_hint: She might resent you for this

dialogue.content: Chen Ji looked at Su Qingyao, his eyes completely unmoved. He gently pushed aside the sword she held before her, his voice cold as frost: "This is a matter of the Chen family, none of your concern. Go back to being the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow, continue being the young lady of Tianqing Sect. Everything that happens here, you know nothing about." His tone was calm, yet carried an unquestionable resolve. Su Qingyao stared at him in disbelief, her lips trembling slightly: "You... is that how you see me? Three years, I chased you, suspected you, investigated you... and in the end, I don't even deserve an explanation?" Her voice grew louder and louder, finally almost a shout.

text.content: Chen Ji turned his back to her, refusing to look at her. He knew that any softness at this moment could be fatal. "Indeed, you don't deserve it." He said flatly, "Because you aren't qualified enough for me to trust." These words were like a sharp blade, stabbing violently into Su Qingyao's heart. She froze, tears swirled in her eyes but stubbornly refused to fall. Chen Ji didn't look back, his figure gradually disappeared into the night. Su Qingyao stood there, her fists clenched until her knuckles turned white, murmuring softly: "Chen Ji... you wait for me..."

choices.memory_label: 苏青瑶被陈机推开，心生怨恨，但这份怨恨之下是更深的执念

choices.text: Set up a scheme to have her join
choices.description: Use her abilities, design a situation where she "has no choice" but to act together—not out of trust, but for maximum benefit
choices.visible_cost: Consume 20 points of Heavenly Fate to set up a trap
choices.visible_reward: Su Qingyao becomes a chess piece rather than an ally, action success rate increases
choices.risk_hint: If discovered cheating, might completely lose her

text.content: A gleam of sharpness flickered in Chen Ji's eyes. He suddenly changed his mind. Su Qingyao was the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow of Tianqing Sect, her identity itself was the best pass. If he could draw her into the game as well... Chen Ji turned around, a gentle smile appearing on his face: "Qingyao, you misunderstand me. I didn't tell you because this matter involves too much—the more you know, the more dangerous it becomes." He walked closer to her, lowering his voice: "However, since you insist on knowing... I can tell you, but I need your help." Su Qingyao looked at him with suspicion, yet still nodded. Chen Ji's smile deepened—there was another usable chess piece on this board.

choices.memory_label: 陈机将苏青瑶纳入计划，她暂时成为行动的一环

text.content: While Chen Ji and Su Qingyao confronted each other, far away in the depths of the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds at the Heavenly Fate Altar, a pair of eyes slowly opened. It was a young girl bound by iron chains at the altar's center. Her body was weak to the extreme, but those eyes remained clear—just like Chen Ji's. Chen Nian. Her lips moved slightly, as if murmuring something: "Brother... I can feel it... you came..." Tears welled in her eyes, yet her body couldn't move due to the suppression of the seal. The surrounding space began to distort, and the whispers of the Heavenly Eye sounded again: "Interesting... he actually dares to come."

Above the Heavenly Fate Altar, Ling Yuan stood with hands behind his back, gazing down at the imprisoned Chen Nian. His face still wore that scholarly, gentle appearance, but his eyes carried a twisted glee. "Twenty years." He said softly, "Chen Xuan, you never would have imagined that your son would come to me voluntarily, right?" He raised his hand, injecting spiritual energy into the altar. Chen Nian's body immediately convulsed violently. A illusory image rose from her—the shadow of the Tianji Record, the key to opening a certain "door." Ling Yuan's smile grew colder and more sinister: "Come, all of you, come. As long as he dares set foot here, I will let him watch with his own eyes as the person most important to him dies."

In another part of the ruins, Ye Qing stood beside Han Lie's corpse, her Demonic Path mist concealing all traces thoroughly. She looked down at the communication jade slip Han Lie had left before his death, a strange glint flickering in her eyes. "The Heavenly Eye won't let you go..." she murmured, "Chen Ji, oh Chen Ji, just what kind of thing have you gotten yourself into?" She hesitated for a moment, then ultimately stored that jade slip in her sleeve. No matter what, she needed to know more. Because she had a intuition—this man might be the only light in the darkness of the Holy Sect. In the distance, from the direction of Tianqing Sect, a sudden commotion arose, as if something major was about to happen. Ye Qing raised her head, gazing at that sky, and said softly: "It seems... the chaotic times are truly coming."

Chen Ji stood at the edge of the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds, gazing at that blood-colored sky. The images from the因果追溯 (Karmic Retrospection) still echoed in his mind—his sister's suffering, Ling Yuan's triumphant smile, his father's lonely back... all of it intertwined, transforming into a torrent of rage burning in his chest. He took a deep breath, suppressing all emotions. The Tianji Record Fragment within him grew slightly warm, and Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded again: "Young master, are you certain you want to enter? The layout inside is far more dangerous than you can imagine." Chen Ji didn't answer, only slowly lifted his foot, walking toward that blood-colored forbidden land that had swallowed countless lives. His voice was very light, yet carried unquestionable firmness: "From the moment I decided to walk this path, there was never any room to turn back." The wind blew past, his figure disappeared into the darkness. And behind him, the threads of因果 (karma) shook violently, as if predicting some momentous event about to occur. The chess game of destiny was accelerating toward its endgame.
